method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Compilation No. 104, compilation date 1 July 2026 (includes amendments up to Act No. 17, 2025), register id C2026C00297, deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2004A01234.txt; no regulation or guideline deposited; repayment thresholds and rates are the Act's own ($67,000 and $125,000; 15%, 17%, 10% cap) for 2025-26, indexed figures for later years are inputs; the formulas the Register prints as images (ss 93-5(1), 140-25(1), 140-26(2), 154-25(2)) are absent from the deposit

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the student and the former student repaying: ss 36-5, 36-10 (Commonwealth supported student); ss 90-1, 90-5, 93-1, 93-10, 93-20, 96-1 (HECS-HELP); ss 104-1, 104-5 (FEE-HELP); ss 128-15, 128-20, 128-25 (HELP balance, loan limit, re-crediting on repayment); ss 137-5, 137-10, 137-19A (HELP debts, the FEE-HELP loan fee, the 2025 20% cut); ss 137-20, 140-40 (discharge on death); ss 140-5, 140-10, 140-25, 140-26, 140-30 (accumulated HELP debt and indexation); ss 151-1, 151-10, 151-15 (voluntary repayment); ss 154-1, 154-5, 154-10, 154-15, 154-20, 154-25 (compulsory repayment: $67,000 minimum for 2025-26, 15%/17% marginal rates, 10% cap, indexed thresholds as inputs); s 154-18(1) (notice on leaving Australia)
seat: the student, and later the former student repaying a HELP debt
